product.title: Meridian ANC
product.tagline: Wireless over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancelling

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Quiet, on your terms
sections.body: Eight microphones listen to the room 50,000 times a second and cancel what you don't want to hear. Turn the dial on the left cup to let the world back in.

sections.label: Sound
sections.heading: 40 mm drivers, tuned flat
sections.body: Studio-reference tuning with a gentle lift below 80 Hz. A five-band EQ in the app if you want more.

sections.label: Reviews
